# Bloom vectors: <label> <logs> <bloom>
# logs is comma-separated log RLP, `-` for no logs; bloom is 512 hex
# characters. All hex is without 0x.
#
# corpus-*  THE BLOOM THAT SHIPPED BESIDE THOSE LOGS, read from the same
#           receipt that published them. Same release as the log vectors.
# the rest  Computed by the executable specification's own logs_bloom.
#
# The two sources were checked against each other over the whole corpus:
# 2193 receipts, and the specification's logs_bloom reproduced the
# published bloom in every one, with 0 disagreements.
#
# The Yellow Paper (efc5f9a) defines the same function as
#   M(O) = OR over x in {O_a} + O_t of M_3:2048(x)
# setting bit 2047 - (KEC(x)[i,i+1] mod 2048) for i in {0,2,4}, bits
# indexed from 0 at the MOST significant end. go-ethereum's bloom9.go and
# besu's LogsBloomFilter agree: with m = 8q + r all of them reduce to byte
# 255-q, bit 1<<r.
#
# A row carries its logs as RLP rather than as fields, so reading it
# exercises the log decoder too. That coupling is deliberate and is stated
# in the spec that consumes this file.
